subject: Accessing shiny session from third party site

messages.author: 4f7a5acb935c2149
messages.subject: Accessing shiny session from third party site
parts:
Hi,
I have a web page which uses R at the back-end, now I want to embed few shiny reactive html components without launching new browser or creating a new websocket. How I should go about it ? Do we have any API's apart from shinyApp or runApp which gives me input, output and session parameters so that I can use them in my application effectively.

messages.author: edbcc711cdbb3da8
messages.subject: Re: [shinyapps-users] Accessing shiny session from third party site
parts:
When you say you have a web page that uses R as a back-end, are you using Shiny for this application, or are you using some other stack to launch and manage the R process? 
If it is the latter, there is no such API, Shiny is meant to be the framework that facilitates the creation of interactive web applications on top of R.
